words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: v. 用喙整理羽毛；精心打扮；感觉良好
words.ex: The bird preens its feathers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟每天早上梳理它的羽毛。
words.en: If a bird preens or preens itself, it cleans and arranges its feathers using its beak.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.tr:
n. 波利尼西亚人；
adj. 波利尼西亚（人）的；
words.ex: The Polynesian sailed across the Pacific Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这位波利尼西亚人横渡了太平洋。
words.en: Of or relating to Polynesia, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: Adam likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 亚当喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: In the Bible, Adam is the first man created by God and the ancestor of all humans.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.ex: He shows biophilia by caring for plants every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天照顾植物，表现出对自然的热爱。
words.en: A love of life and the living world; the innate affinity of human beings for other life forms.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: Yamashita is a Japanese surname, often found in historical records.
words.ex_cn: 山下是一个日本姓氏，经常出现在历史记录中。

words.ex: The instructions are unclear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明不清楚。
words.en: If something is unclear, it is not obvious or easy to see, understand, or be certain about.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.ex: The implementation of the new rule took one month.
words.ex_cn: 新规则的履行花了一个月。
words.en: The act of putting a decision or plan into effect; execution.

words.tr: n. 音盲者；缺乏音乐感的人 无中文释义
words.ex: Amusics cannot tell the difference between two musical notes.
words.ex_cn: 音盲的人无法分辨两个音符的区别。

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr: n. 变色龙；见风使舵的人
words.ex: The chameleon changes color to hide.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙改变颜色来隐藏自己。
words.en: A chameleon is a type of lizard that can change the color of its skin in order to blend in with its surroundings.

words.ex: The car moved rapidly down the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车迅速地沿着道路行驶。
words.en: If something happens rapidly, it happens very quickly.

words.ex: Martin is my neighbor who loves gardening.
words.ex_cn: 马丁是我的邻居，他喜欢园艺。
words.en: A common male given name.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: She visited the famous Hidcote garden in the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她在春天参观了著名的希德科特花园。

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr: n. 依恋；附件；附加装置；
words.ex: The child showed strong attachment to his teddy bear.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对他的泰迪熊产生了强烈的依恋。
words.en: An attachment is a file that is sent along with an email message.

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: The immigrants quickly learned the language and culture, showing rapid assimilation.
words.ex_cn: 这些移民很快学会了语言和文化，显示出快速的同化。
words.en: The process of taking in and fully understanding information or ideas.

words.ex: He showed great enthusiasm for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习英语表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Enthusiasm is a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: He can articulate his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and clearly.

words.ex: He lives in Spain.
words.ex_cn: 他住在西班牙。
words.en: Spain is a country located in southwestern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.tr: v. 供应；提供；报价；“offer”的现在分词； n. 出售物；作品；
words.ex: The store is offering fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天早上供应新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: An offering is something that is produced for other people to use, watch, or enjoy, or the act of producing it.

words.tr:
n. 波斯人；波斯语
adj. 波斯人的；波斯语的
words.ex: He is a persian from Iran.
words.ex_cn: 他是来自伊朗的波斯人。
words.en: Relating to Persia (now Iran), its people, or their language.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，鸟儿飞向南方。
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.ex: He did a good deed for his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他为邻居做了一件好事。
words.en: A deed is something that is done, especially something that is very good or very bad. It can also refer to a legal document that is signed and delivered, especially one regarding the ownership of property or legal rights.

words.ex: The company sells its products globally.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在全球范围内销售其产品。
words.en: In a way that relates to the whole world; worldwide.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: Janet walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 珍妮特每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A common female given name, often used as a standalone name or as a diminutive of Janet or Jane.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.tr:
n. 碾磨
adj. 乱兜圈子的；成群乱转的
v. 碾碎；磨碎；“mill”的现在分词
words.ex: The milling of wheat into flour is a common process.
words.ex_cn: 将小麦磨成面粉是一个常见的过程。
words.en: The process of grinding or crushing something, especially grain, in a mill; or the process of cutting or shaping metal with a rotating tool.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.ex: Neff is a name, not a word with a specific meaning.
words.ex_cn: Neff 是一个名字，没有特定含义。

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.tr: v. 吸引；"draw"的过去分词；画；拉；提取；“draw”的过去分词；
words.ex: The bright colors drawn the children's attention.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了孩子们的注意。
words.en: If someone looks drawn, their face is thin and they look very tired, ill, worried, or unhappy.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.ex: He goes to kindergarten every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上幼儿园。
words.en: A kindergarten is a school or class for young children, usually between the ages of four and six.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.ex: The Scot was proud of his heritage.
words.ex_cn: 这位苏格兰人以他的传统为荣。
words.en: A Scot is a person from Scotland.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: The traveller visited five countries last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者去年夏天访问了五个国家。
words.en: A traveller is a person who is travelling or who often travels.

words.tr: n. 出版（业）；出版社； v. 发布；出版；“publish”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works in publishing.
words.ex_cn: 他在出版业工作。
words.en: Publishing is the profession or business of producing and selling books, magazines, or newspapers.

words.ex: The potter made a clay bowl by hand.
words.ex_cn: 陶工用手制作了一个陶碗。
words.en: A potter is someone who makes pottery, and to potter means to busy oneself in a desultory but pleasant manner.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.ex: The word 'murry' is not a standard English word.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'murry' 不是标准英语单词。

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: Workers excavate the old ruins with shovels.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用铲子挖掘古代遗址。
words.en: To excavate means to dig in the ground in order to find things that have been buried there, such as archaeological remains.

words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: The past tense of wear, meaning to have clothing, jewelry, etc., on your body.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr: v. 跌倒；下降；砍伐；“fall”的过去式；
words.ex: He fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔了下来。
words.en: To cut down (a tree); to knock down (a person or animal); the skin of an animal with the hair or wool still on it; fierce or cruel.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.tr: n. 倡议；主动权；自发性；措施；
words.ex: The school launched an initiative to reduce plastic use.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一项减少塑料使用的倡议。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.ex: He looked afar and saw a small boat.
words.ex_cn: 他远远地望见了一条小船。
words.en: At, to, or from a great distance.

words.ex: Johanson is a scientist who discovered an ancient fossil.
words.ex_cn: 约翰森是一位发现了古代化石的科学家。

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: n. 约克郡（英国英格兰原郡名）
words.ex: Yorkshire is known for its beautiful countryside and historical sites.
words.ex_cn: 约克郡以其美丽的乡村和历史遗迹而闻名。
words.en: A historic county in northern England, known for its rich history, culture, and natural beauty.

words.tr: v. 使计算机化；用计算机做
words.ex: The school will computerise its records next year.
words.ex_cn: 学校明年将把记录电脑化。
words.en: To computerise something means to use a computer to control, organize, or automate a process or system.

words.tr:
adj. 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的；
n. 意大利语；意大利人；
words.ex: She loves italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢意大利食物。
words.en: Of or relating to Italy, its people, or its language.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.tr: v. 继续；“continue”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 继续的；延续的；
words.ex: He continued walking after the rain stopped.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后，他继续走路。
words.en: If something continues, or if you continue it, it does not stop happening.

words.ex: He greatly improved his English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语进步了很多。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; very much.

words.tr: n. 达·芬奇（意大利文艺复兴时期的艺术家和科学家）
words.ex: He loves to paint like Vinci.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢像达芬奇一样绘画。
words.en: A reference to Leonardo da Vinci, the Italian polymath of the Renaissance.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: n. 塞格尔（人名）；（尤指法律文件上的）印章，印鉴
words.ex: He uses a siegel to seal the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个封印来封信封。
words.en: A German surname, often associated with the philosopher Ludwig Siegel or the mathematician Siegfried Siegel.

words.ex: Bocherens is a scientist who studies ancient diets using isotopes.
words.ex_cn: 博赫伦是一位使用同位素研究古代饮食的科学家。

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.tr:
n. 骗局；恶作剧；戏弄
v. 愚弄
words.ex: The news was a hoax to scare people.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻是个骗局，为了吓唬人。
words.en: A hoax is a plan to deceive someone, such as telling the police there is a bomb somewhere when there is not, or a trick in which someone tells people a lie.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: This store sells inexpensive clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖不贵的衣服。
words.en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost a lot of money.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: The doctor used tomography to see inside the patient's body.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用断层扫描来查看病人体内的情况。
words.en: A technique for displaying a representation of a cross section through a human body or other solid object using X-rays or ultrasound.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.ex_cn: 大厅里有一百名学生。
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.ex: He will initiate a new project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周发起一个新项目。
words.en: To initiate something means to start it or cause it to happen.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: He was seriously injured in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中严重受伤。
words.en: In a serious manner; not lightly or casually.

words.tr:
n. 地中海；
adj. 地中海的；
words.ex: He sailed across the Mediterranean last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天横渡了地中海。
words.en: relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.ex: Mehrabian's rule shows that body language matters more than words in communication.
words.ex_cn: 梅拉比安法则表明，在沟通中肢体语言比语言本身更重要。

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The word 'nystuen' is not recognized in standard English.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'nystuen' 在标准英语中不被认可。

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: Leonardo da Vinci was a renowned artist and inventor.
words.ex_cn: n. 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一位著名的艺术家和发明家。
words.en: Leonardo is a masculine given name of Italian origin, derived from the Germanic name Leonhard, meaning 'brave lion'.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.ex: The accident occurs on a rainy day.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生在雨天。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: The company made drastic cuts to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司进行了急剧的削减以节省资金。
words.en: If you describe a change or action as drastic, you mean that it is extreme and often severe.

words.ex: The water is unfrozen after the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 太阳出来后，水解冻了。

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.tr: n. 赛璐珞；电影胶片；假象牙
words.ex: The old movie was made on celluloid.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是用胶片拍摄的。
words.en: Celluloid is a type of plastic that was used especially in the past for making films, toys, and other objects.

words.tr: adj. 装饰性的；作装饰用的；
words.ex: The room has decorative flowers on the table.
words.ex_cn: 房间里桌上有一些装饰性的花。
words.en: Something that is decorative is intended to look pretty or attractive.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: He learned papermaking from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里学会了造纸。
words.en: Process or industry of making paper from wood pulp or other fibrous materials.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.tr: v. 买；“buy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I bought a book yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天买了一本书。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of buy, meaning to acquire something by paying for it.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.tr: adj. 贸易的； n. 贸易；买卖； v. 贸易；交易；“trade”的现在分词；
words.ex: The trading market is very active today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的贸易市场非常活跃。
words.en: The activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, companies, or countries.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.tr: v. 编织；编制；“weave”的过去分词；
words.ex: She woven a blanket with colorful threads.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩色线编织了一条毯子。
words.en: Made by weaving; interwoven.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: The child gave an imaginative story about flying cats.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子讲了一个关于会飞的猫的富有想象力的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or their ideas as imaginative, you are praising them because they are easily able to think of or create new or exciting things.

words.tr: adj. 纯的；纯净的；纯粹的；
words.ex: She drank pure water from the spring.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了从泉水中取的纯净水。
words.en: Something that is pure is clean and does not contain any harmful substances.

words.ex: Ruamahanga is a river in New Zealand.
words.ex_cn: Ruamahanga 是新西兰的一条河流。

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: Oscar won a prize for his painting.
words.ex_cn: 奥斯卡因他的画作获奖了。
words.en: An Oscar is an award given by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences for excellence in cinematic achievements.

words.ex: The farmer spreads fertiliser on the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田地里施化肥。
words.en: A fertiliser is a substance that is added to soil to improve its quality and fertility, helping plants to grow better.

words.tr: n. 哈佛大学（美国著名大学）
words.ex: He got accepted to Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他被哈佛大学录取了。
words.en: Harvard refers to Harvard University, a prestigious Ivy League research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: Barrett won the science competition last year.
words.ex_cn: 巴雷特去年赢得了科学竞赛。
words.en: A proper noun, typically used as a surname, for example, associated with a person or a brand.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr: adv. 确切地；正是；准确地；
words.ex: He arrived exactly at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他正好在八点到达。
words.en: In a precise manner; accurately.

words.ex: The flytrap catches flies with its sticky leaves.
words.ex_cn: 捕蝇草用它黏稠的叶子捕捉苍蝇。
words.en: A flytrap is a plant that catches and digests insects, especially flies, as a means of obtaining nutrients.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.tr:
adj. 埃及的；
n. 埃及语；
words.ex: She bought an Egyptian scarf at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一条埃及风格的围巾。
words.en: Of or relating to Egypt or its people, language, or culture.

words.tr: v. 挑选；采摘； adj. 采摘（pick 的过去式）；
words.ex: He picked the red apple from the basket.
words.ex_cn: 他从篮子里挑了那个红苹果。
words.en: To choose or select something from a group or to remove something from a place where it is attached.

words.ex: The curator arranged the paintings in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 馆长在博物馆里布置了这些画作。
words.en: A curator is someone who is in charge of the objects or works of art in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: The coil has an inductance of 5 henry.
words.ex_cn: 这个线圈的电感为5亨。
words.en: A male given name.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.ex: Rawlinson was a famous archaeologist who studied ancient tablets.
words.ex_cn: 劳林森是一位著名的考古学家，研究古代石板。

words.ex: Lennard is a name, not a word with a specific meaning in English.
words.ex_cn: Lennard 是一个名字，在英语中没有特定含义。

words.tr: n. 玩具娃娃制造者；玩偶制作人
words.ex: The dollmakers crafted tiny clothes for the dolls.
words.ex_cn: 玩偶制作者为玩偶制作了微小的衣服。

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了鞋子。
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.tr: v. 抓住；赶上；“catch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boy caught a fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在河里抓到了一条鱼。
words.en: Caught is the past tense and past participle of catch, which means to seize or capture something or someone.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr: adv. 总的来说；总而言之。无中文释义
words.ex: He is lazy, withall he tries his best.
words.ex_cn: 他虽然懒，但还是尽力了。

words.ex: The royal family lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇室住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royal is used to describe something that is connected with a king, queen, or emperor, or with their family. It can also describe something that is splendid or magnificent, befitting a king or queen.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: The spokesman spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a man who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.ex: The ship uses navigational tools to find its way.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用航行工具来确定方向。
words.en: Relating to the process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.tr:
n. （马等动物的）蹄
v.  走；步行；以蹄踢（踏）
words.ex: The horse stepped on the rock with its hoof.
words.ex_cn: 马用蹄子踩在石头上。
words.en: The horny part of the foot of an ungulate animal, especially a horse.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: Zandbergen is a surname, not a common English word.
words.ex_cn: 赞德伯根是一个姓氏，不是常见的英语单词。

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr: n. 加利福尼亚（美国州名）
words.ex: He lives in California.
words.ex_cn: 他住在加利福尼亚。
words.en: A state in the western United States on the Pacific Ocean; known for its diverse geography and culture.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: n. 爱尔兰人（有时带有贬义）
words.ex: He was often called a mick because of his Irish heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他因为爱尔兰血统经常被称为mick。
words.en: A term used to refer to an Irish person, sometimes considered offensive.

words.ex: Mr. Pearce teaches math at our school.
words.ex_cn: 皮尔斯先生在我们学校教数学。
words.en: A surname, possibly referring to a person (e.g., Pearce, a character in Shaw's 'Pygmalion').

words.ex: A gnat flew into my room through the window.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子从窗户飞进了我的房间。
words.en: A gnat is a very small flying insect that bites people and usually lives near water.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: Monteiro is a Portuguese football player.
words.ex_cn: 蒙泰罗是一名葡萄牙足球运动员。

words.ex: He showed conformity with the group's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了小组的规定。
words.en: Conformity is the act of matching attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors to group norms or standards.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr: n. 霉菌；菌类；真菌；“fungus”的复数；
words.ex: The bread has fungi growing on it.
words.ex_cn: 面包上长了霉菌。
words.en: Fungi are a group of living organisms which are classified in their own kingdom. This means they are not animals, plants, or bacteria. Fungi include mushrooms, molds, and yeasts.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: Her teacher encourages her to speak more in class.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师鼓励她在课堂上多发言。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr: adj. 著名的；有名的；闻名的
words.ex: He is a famed painter in his country.
words.ex_cn: 他是他国家里著名的画家。
words.en: Known about by many people; renowned.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: The bison walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 野牛慢慢地走过草原。
words.en: A bison is a large, wild animal that is related to the cow and is native to North America and Europe. Bison have a large head, a humped back, and are covered with thick, shaggy hair.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.tr: n. （非正式）一种由面包屑、鸡蛋和奶酪制成的烤制食品，常用于制作三明治或作为配菜（源自德语 'Beköf'，但该词在英语中并不常见，可能为方言或误拼）
words.ex: Bekoff is a scientist who studies animal emotions.
words.ex_cn: 贝科夫是一位研究动物情感的科学家。
words.en: A surname, possibly referring to a specific individual, but not a common English word with a standard definition.

words.ex: The region is known for its malarial swamps.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区以其疟疾肆虐的沼泽而闻名。
words.en: Relating to or affected by malaria.

words.ex: He lives in Montana with his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他和狗住在蒙大拿。
words.en: A state in the northwestern United States, known for its mountainous terrain and natural beauty.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: Jason is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 杰森是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Ιάσων (Iason), which possibly means 'healer'.

words.ex: The word 'jenness' is not a recognized English word.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'jenness' 不是公认的英语单词。

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.ex: The plant develops quickly in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在阳光下迅速成长。
words.en: If you develop something, you make it grow, change, or become more advanced.

words.tr:
n. 医学；医术；泻药
v. 给…吃药；治愈
words.ex: He studied physic in ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 他在古代学习医学。
words.en: Physic refers to the art or science of healing, especially the branch of medicine that deals with the use of drugs and other nonsurgical remedies.

words.ex: Please specify the time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 请详细说明会议的时间。
words.en: If you specify something, you give information about what is required or should happen in a certain situation.

words.tr: n. 蚁属名（沙漠蚂蚁的一种），无中文释义
words.ex: Cataglyphis ants survive in extreme desert heat by moving quickly.
words.ex_cn: 猫蚁通过快速移动在极端沙漠高温中生存。

words.tr: n. 丘吉尔（姓氏）；温斯顿·丘吉尔（Winston Churchill，1874-1965，英国政治家，曾任英国首相）
words.ex: Winston Churchill was a prominent British statesman during World War II.
words.ex_cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔是二战期间英国杰出的政治家。
words.en: A common surname, also the name of several places, including the British capital of the Northwest Territories, Canada, and a town in Ontario.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.tr: n. 浓汤（尤指以贝类为主料的）
words.ex: She ordered a bowl of lobster bisque for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚餐点了一碗龙虾浓汤。
words.en: A thick, creamy soup, especially one made from shellfish.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: Quinine is used to treat malaria.
words.ex_cn: 奎宁用于治疗疟疾。
words.en: A bitter crystalline compound present in cinchona bark, used as a tonic and formerly to treat malaria.

words.tr: n. 放牧；草场； v. 吃草；“graze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The farmers practice grazing on the open land.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在开阔的土地上进行放牧。
words.en: The act of animals feeding on grass or the land where such feeding occurs.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: The new dance became a craze among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这种新舞蹈在青少年中成为了一种狂热。
words.en: A craze is an activity, object, or idea that is extremely popular, usually for a short time.

words.tr: v. 挑战；质疑；“challenge”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 残障的；
words.ex: He challenged his friend to a race.
words.ex_cn: 他挑战朋友比赛跑步。
words.en: If you say that someone is challenged in a particular way, you mean that they have a disability or difficulty with something.

words.tr:
n. 阿芝台克人；阿芝台克语
adj. 阿芝台克人的；阿芝台克语的
words.ex: The Aztec civilization was known for its advanced architecture and complex society.
words.ex_cn: 阿兹特克文明以其先进的建筑和复杂的社会而闻名。
words.en: A member of the Nahuatl-speaking people who established an empire in Mexico that was overthrown by Cortes in 1521.

words.ex: He shook the bottle vigorously.
words.ex_cn: 他有力地摇晃了瓶子。
words.en: If you do something vigorously, you do it with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: Alison was known for her kindness and intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 艾莉森以她的善良和智慧著称。
words.en: A common female given name, often used in contexts like celebrities or individuals, such as the British actress Alison Sudol.

words.ex: The word 'qrio' is not a recognized English word.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'qrio' 不是公认的英文单词。

words.ex: He finished in seventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第七名。
words.en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He is traveling to Brazil next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要去巴西旅行。
words.en: Brazil is a country in South America, known for its vast Amazon rainforest and vibrant culture.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: Zubrin is a scientist who advocates for Mars exploration.
words.ex_cn: 祖布林是一位倡导火星探索的科学家。

words.ex: McKay is a teacher who loves math.
words.ex_cn: 麦凯是一位喜欢数学的老师。

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: He was cooking dinner. Meanwhile, his daughter did her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做晚饭，与此同时，他的女儿在做作业。
words.en: In the intervening period of time; at the same time.

words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: v. 发现； adj. 无盖的，未保险的 v. 揭开…的盖子( uncover的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The detective uncovered the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探发现了真相。
words.en: If something is uncovered, it has no covering or protection.

words.ex: He made a table from hardwood.
words.ex_cn: 他用硬木做了一张桌子。
words.en: Hardwood is wood from broad-leaved trees such as oak, ash, or beech, as opposed to conifers.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The nutritionist gave her advice on eating healthy.
words.ex_cn: 营养师给了她关于健康饮食的建议。
words.en: A nutritionist is a person who is an expert in the field of nutrition and who advises people on what to eat in order to be healthy.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.ex: He commonly eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他一般在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: If something is commonly the case, it is usually or often the case.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.tr: adj. 可更新的；可再生的；
words.ex: Solar energy is a renewable resource.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能是一种可更新的资源。
words.en: A renewable resource is a natural resource which will replenish to replace the portion depleted by usage and consumption, either through natural reproduction or other recurring processes in a finite amount of time in a human time scale.

words.ex: She lives in Indonesia.
words.ex_cn: 她住在印度尼西亚。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, consisting of an archipelago between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific Ocean, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and biodiversity.

words.ex: Elliott is a popular name in English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: 埃利奥特是英语国家中一个常见的名字。
words.en: A common English surname, possibly derived from a diminutive of Elias.

words.ex: The word 'valenza' is not recognized in standard English.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'valenza' 在标准英语中不被识别。

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: He was born in Tilburg, a city in the Netherlands.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在荷兰的一个城市蒂尔堡。

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: He picked a red raspberry from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一颗红树莓。
words.en: A raspberry is a small, soft red fruit that grows on bushes. It is also used to denote a sound made to express derision or contempt.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.tr: v. 寻求；“seek”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sought help from his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopaedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找了这个词。
words.en: A book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: He looked up the word in Britannica.
words.ex_cn: 他从《大英百科全书》中查找了这个词。
words.en: Encyclopædia Britannica, a well-known English-language encyclopedia.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃米饭。
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.ex: The old woman made a prophecy about the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言了会有雨。
words.en: A prophecy is a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magical powers.

words.ex: Glaeser is a professor at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 格莱泽是哈佛大学的一名教授。

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: He responded negatively to the proposal.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议持消极态度。
words.en: In a manner that is negative or pessimistic.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果重一公斤。
words.en: A kilogram is a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，不喜欢做作业。
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.tr: v. 减到最少；使最小化；
words.ex: Try to minimize waste in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 尽量减少厨房里的浪费。
words.en: To minimize something means to reduce it to the smallest possible amount or degree.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.ex: The Inuit live in cold northern regions.
words.ex_cn: 因纽特人生活在寒冷的北方地区。
words.en: The Inuit are a group of culturally similar indigenous peoples inhabiting the Arctic regions of Greenland, Canada, and Alaska.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr:
v. 挖洞；钻进；翻寻
n. 地洞
words.ex: The rabbit burrows under the tree.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在树下打洞。
words.en: A burrow is a hole or tunnel dug by a small animal, such as a rabbit or a mole, as a dwelling. As a verb, to burrow means to dig a hole or tunnel for habitation or refuge.

words.tr: n. 刚出壳的雏鸟或小动物
words.ex: The hatchling broke out of its egg this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只幼崽今天早上破壳而出。
words.en: A hatchling is a young bird, fish, or reptile that has recently emerged from its egg.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: Stephen is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 斯蒂芬正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name of English origin, meaning 'crown' or 'garland'.

words.ex: The elderly man walks slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位年老的男子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: An elderly person is someone who is old or aging.

words.ex: He performed remarkably well in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中表现得非常出色。
words.en: In a way that is worthy of attention; strikingly.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: He lives in Chicago.
words.ex_cn: 他住在芝加哥。
words.en: Chicago is a large city in the northeastern Illinois on Lake Michigan, known for its vibrant arts scene, architectural landmarks, and deep-dish pizza.

words.ex: Penguins live in Antarctica.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极洲。
words.en: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost continent, containing the geographic South Pole. It is situated in the Antarctic region of the Southern Hemisphere, almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle, and is surrounded by the Southern Ocean.

words.ex: The falcon flew high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 猎鹰在群山上空飞翔。
words.en: A falcon is a bird of prey, known for its speed and keen eyesight, used in falconry.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.tr: v. 悬挂；“hang”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He hung the picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把画挂在墙上。
words.en: to suspend or be suspended from above with the lower part dangling free

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: Walter walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 沃尔特每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: Walter is a male given name of Old German origin, meaning 'ruler of the army'.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr: adv. 与环境有关地；在环境方面地；
words.ex: We should environmentally friendly products.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该购买与环境有关的产品。
words.en: In a way that relates to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: He lives in Holland with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在荷兰。
words.en: Holland is a region and former province on the western coast of the Netherlands. The name Holland is also frequently used informally to refer to the whole of the country of the Netherlands.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.tr:
v. 航行；驾（船）；
n. 帆；航行；航海；
words.ex: They sail to the island every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都乘船航行到那个岛。
words.en: To sail means to travel on water in a ship or boat, especially one that uses sails to catch the wind.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五十美元。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.tr:
adj. 拉丁语的；拉丁语系国家的；
n. 拉丁语；
words.ex: He read a latin text in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上读了一篇拉丁语文本。
words.en: Latin is the language of ancient Rome and its empire, widely used historically as a language of scholarship and administration.

words.tr: n. 食品贮藏室；食品柜
words.ex: She stored bread in the larder.
words.ex_cn: 她把面包存放在食品储藏室里。
words.en: A larder is a cool area in a house where food is stored.

words.ex: Can you summarise the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarise something, you give a summary of it.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: Merriam is a well-known publisher of dictionaries.
words.ex_cn: 梅里亚姆是一家知名词典出版社。

words.ex: Olsen is a common surname in Scandinavian countries.
words.ex_cn: Olsen是斯堪的纳维亚国家常见的姓氏。

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The actual cost was lower than expected.
words.ex_cn: 实际成本比预期的低。
words.en: You use actual to emphasize that you are referring to something real or genuine.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去看了电影。
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴削弱了那座旧桥。
words.en: To weaken something means to reduce its strength, intensity, or effectiveness.

words.ex: Markus likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 马库斯喜欢放学后踢足球。

words.tr: n. 达尔（一种用豆类或扁豆煮成的印度菜）
words.ex: He loves eating roasted dahl with rice.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢用米饭吃烤好的扁豆。
words.en: A type of Indian stew or curry, typically made with lentils or vegetables and seasoned with spices.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: The school is five kilometres from my house.
words.ex_cn: 学校离我家五公里。
words.en: A kilometre is a unit of length equal to 1,000 metres, or approximately 0.621 miles.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.ex: Manicouagan is a large circular lake in Quebec, Canada.
words.ex_cn: 马尼库agan是加拿大魁北克省的一个大型圆形湖泊。

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.ex: He misdated the letter as 2020 instead of 2023.
words.ex_cn: 他把信的日期错误地标注为2020年，而不是2023年。
words.en: Misdate: To assign an incorrect date to a document, event, or object; to date something inaccurately.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.tr: v. 评价；判断；裁决（judge 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The teacher judged his answer as correct.
words.ex_cn: 老师评价他的答案是正确的。
words.en: To form an opinion or conclusion about something or someone based on evidence or reasoning.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.ex: The chemist used vinyl to make a new plastic.
words.ex_cn: 化学家使用乙烯基制造了一种新的塑料。
words.en: Vinyl is a strong plastic used for making things such as floor coverings and furniture. It is also used to make records that music is recorded on.

words.ex: What happens when it rains?
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时会发生什么？
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: Mattison is a surname and does not have a specific meaning in English.
words.ex_cn: Mattison 是一个姓氏，在英语中没有特定含义。

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: Monkeys and apes are primates.
words.ex_cn: 猴子和猿类是灵长类动物。
words.en: A primate is a member of the most developed and intelligent group of mammals, which includes humans, apes, and monkeys. In a religious context, a primate can also refer to the chief bishop or archbishop in a province or country.

words.ex: The road extends to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条路延伸到山脉。
words.en: To make something longer or larger in space or time.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The term 'holdaway' is not a standard English word.
words.ex_cn: ‘holdaway’不是一个标准的英语单词。

words.ex: The company has an offshore office in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在爱尔兰有一个离岸办公室。
words.en: Located or based in a foreign country, especially to take advantage of lower costs or less stringent regulations.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
n. 长矛；狗鱼
v. 用长矛刺
words.ex: The soldier held a sharp pike in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 士兵手里拿着一把锋利的长矛。
words.en: A pike is a long thrusting spear formerly used in European warfare from the Late Middle Ages and most of the Early Modern Period, and were wielded by foot soldiers deployed in pike square formation, and it is also a large predatory freshwater fish with a long body and large mouth.

words.tr: n. 毛利人对波利尼西亚鼠的称呼；无中文释义
words.ex: The kiore, a small rat, was brought to New Zealand by early Polynesian settlers.
words.ex_cn: kiore是一种小老鼠，由早期的波利尼西亚定居者带到新西兰。

words.tr:
n. 曲柄杖；钩；弯曲处；骗子
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状
words.ex: The old man walked with a wooden crook.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拿着一根木制曲柄杖走路。
words.en: A crook is a person who is dishonest or a criminal, or it can refer to a bend or curve in something.

words.ex: Leonie is a kind teacher who helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 莱奥妮是一位乐于助人的老师，帮助学生学习数学。

words.ex: He is largely responsible for the project's success.
words.ex_cn: 他主要对这个项目的成功负责。
words.en: To a great extent; mostly.

words.ex: McIntyre is a Scottish surname, often found in historical records.
words.ex_cn: 麦克因泰尔是一个苏格兰姓氏，常出现在历史记录中。

words.ex: She has traveled extensively across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 她广泛地游历了欧洲。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: adj. 充满...的；挤满人的；拥挤的； v. 包装；“pack”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was packed with people.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上挤满了人。
words.en: Filled with a large number of people or things.

words.ex: The truck carries one tonne of coal.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车载着一吨煤。
words.en: A tonne is a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms.

words.ex: This plant has medicinal properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有药用价值。
words.en: Having healing properties; used in the treatment of disease.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: Mimi is my little sister's name.
words.ex_cn: 米米是我妹妹的名字。

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.tr: n. 法语中'清晰'或'明亮'的意思
words.ex: La lumière du clair de lune était magnifique.
words.ex_cn: 月光非常美丽。
words.en: A clear, colorless brandy, originally from France.
