words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: Tanksley is a professor who teaches biology at the university.
words.ex_cn: 坦斯利是一位在大学教授生物学的教授。

words.tr: v. 误解；误会；“misunderstand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He misunderstood her words.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了她的话。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as misunderstood, you mean that people do not understand them and have a wrong impression or idea of them.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.ex: He lives in Berlin.
words.ex_cn: 他住在柏林。
words.en: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany, known for its historical significance, cultural institutions, and modern architecture.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He is the richest man in town.
words.ex_cn: 他是镇上最富有的人。
words.en: Having the most wealth or resources; most valuable or abundant.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He bought a Dunlop tire for his bicycle.
words.ex_cn: 他为自行车买了一个邓禄普轮胎。

words.tr: adj. 错误的；不正确的；不当的；
words.ex: The answer is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是错误的。
words.en: If you say there is something wrong, you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: He solved the math problem independently.
words.ex_cn: 他独立地解决了这道数学题。
words.en: In a way that is free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: Claxton plays basketball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 克拉克顿每个周末都打篮球。
words.en: Claxton is primarily used as a surname. It does not have a specific definition in English dictionaries as it is a proper noun.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: The seabirds swooped down to catch fish in the waves.
words.ex_cn: 海鸟俯冲下来在波浪中捕鱼。
words.en: A seabird is a bird that lives near the sea and gets its food from the sea.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: He tried to counterfeit money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图伪造货币。
words.en: Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 享受；乐趣；乐事；享有；
words.ex: She finds enjoyment in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 她从读书中获得享受。
words.en: The pleasure that you get from something.

words.ex: The statistic shows that 70% of students like math.
words.ex_cn: 这项统计数据表明，70%的学生喜欢数学。
words.en: A statistic is a piece of numerical information obtained from a study of a set of data.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.tr: n. 繁殖者；饲养员；起因
words.ex: The breeder takes care of dogs every day.
words.ex_cn: 繁育者每天照顾狗。
words.en: A breeder is a person who breeds animals or plants professionally.

words.tr: adv. 在国际上；国际性地；
words.ex: This company sells products internationally.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向国际上销售产品。
words.en: In a way that involves or relates to more than one nation.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: The eagle flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 鹰在山上面高飞。
words.en: A large bird of prey with a massive hooked bill and long broad wings, known for its keen sight and powerful soaring flight.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.ex: Try to lessen your sugar intake.
words.ex_cn: 试着减少你的糖摄入量。
words.en: If something lessens or you lessen it, it becomes smaller in size, amount, degree, or importance.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: He bought a replica of the ancient statue.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件古代雕像的复制品。
words.en: A replica of something such as a statue, building, or weapon is an accurate copy of it.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: He is a collector of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位古钱币收藏家。
words.en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: Martina loves to play tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 马丁娜每个周末都喜欢打网球。

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.tr: v. 吸收；“absorb”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sponge absorbed the water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收了水。
words.en: If you are absorbed in something, you are very interested in it and your attention is fully occupied by it.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对上的音乐太响了。
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: Birds are migratory in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天是迁徙的。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by migration; tending to migrate.

words.ex: Children can play freely in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们可以在公园里自由地玩耍。
words.en: If you can do something freely, you can do it without being controlled or restricted by anyone.

words.ex: He lived in a crude hut with no electricity.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个没有电的简陋小屋里。
words.en: A crude substance or product is in its natural state and has not been processed or refined.

words.tr: adj. 塔斯马尼亚的；塔斯马尼亚人的
words.ex: The Tasmanian devil is a carnivorous marsupial found in the wild only on the Australian island state of Tasmania.
words.ex_cn: 塔斯马尼亚恶魔是一种只在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚岛野外发现的肉食性有袋动物。
words.en: Relating to Tasmania, its people, or their culture.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.ex: The poorer families need more help.
words.ex_cn: 更穷的家庭需要更多的帮助。
words.en: Comparative of poor; having less money or fewer possessions than someone else, or than you had before; of a lower quality or standard than someone or something else.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.ex: He is a famous mathematician.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的数学家。
words.en: A mathematician is a person who is an expert in mathematics, a field that uses numbers, formulas, and logical reasoning to solve problems.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.tr: n. 翻新；重大改造；改善外观
words.ex: She gave her room a makeover last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她上周末把房间彻底翻新了。
words.en: A makeover is a complete change of someone's appearance, often including their hair, makeup, and clothes, in order to improve their appearance.

words.ex: He misleads his friends with false stories.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚假的故事误导他的朋友。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me.
words.ex_cn: 慢速的网络让我感到沮丧。
words.en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to deal with the problems it creates.

words.ex: Lawrence is walking to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 劳伦斯每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A male given name, also the name of a city in Massachusetts, USA, and a famous poet (T.S. Eliot).

words.tr: n. 马里奥（男性名字，常用于意大利语名字）
words.ex: Mario plays video games every day.
words.ex_cn: 马里奥每天玩电子游戏。
words.en: A common male given name, of Italian origin, famously associated with the Nintendo video game character.

words.tr: n. 贝利尼（意大利鸡尾酒名）；无中文释义
words.ex: He ordered a bellini at the café.
words.ex_cn: 他在咖啡馆点了一杯贝利尼鸡尾酒。

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.tr:
n. (Greenfield)人名；
adj. 未开发地区的；
words.ex: Greenfield is a famous architect from Canada.
words.ex_cn: 格林菲尔德是来自加拿大的著名建筑师。
words.en: A greenfield project or investment is one that is not constrained by prior work on the site. It is often used in the context of industrial development, where a site is developed from scratch, without the need to consider existing buildings or infrastructure.

words.ex: Susan walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 苏珊每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: A female given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'lily'.

words.ex: The ancient civilization of Persia is renowned for its rich history and culture.
words.ex_cn: 古波斯文明以其丰富的历史和文化而闻名。
words.en: An ancient empire located in what is now Iran, known for its rich history and culture.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: The filmmaker made a movie about dogs.
words.ex_cn: 这位电影制作人拍了一部关于狗的电影。
words.en: A filmmaker is a person who directs or produces movies for the cinema or television.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.tr: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；发愁的； v. 担心；担忧；“worry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was worried about his test results.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的考试成绩。
words.en: If you are worried, you are unhappy because you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: There are twelve apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十二个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and four; one more than eleven, or two less than fourteen; 12.

words.ex: He is inexperienced in managing teams.
words.ex_cn: 他在管理团队方面没有经验。
words.en: If you describe someone as inexperienced, you mean that they have little knowledge or experience of a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: He is a neoclassicist who loves simple, balanced art.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位新古典主义者，喜爱简洁、平衡的艺术。

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.tr: n. 可可；可可树；可可豆；
words.ex: Cacao beans are used to make chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 可可豆用于制作巧克力。
words.en: The cacao tree is a small evergreen tree in the family Malvaceae, native to the deep tropical regions of the Americas. Its seeds, cocoa beans, are used to make cocoa mass, cocoa powder, and chocolate.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr: n. 壁炉的栅栏；护舷；挡泥板；防卫物
words.ex: The ashes fell behind the fender.
words.ex_cn: 灰烬落在了壁炉的栅栏后面。
words.en: A fender is a barrier or cushion between a vehicle and the outside world, designed to absorb the shock of collision or to protect the vehicle's body from damage.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.ex: Katsalidis is an architect known for innovative building designs.
words.ex_cn: 卡tsalidis是一位以创新建筑设计而闻名的建筑师。

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.ex: Importantly, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is important

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: The food has a bad odour.
words.ex_cn: 这食物有一种难闻的气味。
words.en: An odour is a particular and distinctive smell.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: The emergent technology is changing how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 这项新兴技术正在改变我们的交流方式。
words.en: An emergent situation or problem is one that has just started and often requires immediate action.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: The painting evokes a sense of nostalgia.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画唤起了怀旧之情。
words.en: To evoke something means to bring a feeling, memory, or picture into your mind.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr: v. 不同意( disagree的过去式和过去分词 ); （食物）有害健康; 不适合; 不符
words.ex: He disagreed with his friend about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友对这部电影的看法不同。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or correct. You can also say that two people disagree.

words.ex: The analyst studied the data carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位分析者仔细研究了数据。
words.en: An analyst is a person whose job is to analyze a subject and give opinions about it.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.tr: v. 给…排出先后顺序；给…优先权；
words.ex: We need to prioritise the most urgent tasks.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要给最紧急的任务排出先后顺序。
words.en: If you prioritize something, you treat it as more important than other things.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr: v. 将…分类；把…加以归类；
words.ex: We categorise books by genre.
words.ex_cn: 我们按类型对书籍进行分类。
words.en: To categorise means to put people or things into groups according to what type they are.

words.tr: n. 吉布森（一种鸡尾酒，由杜松子酒和干苦艾酒调制而成，通常配以珍珠洋葱）
words.ex: He ordered a gibson at the bar.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧点了一杯吉布森。
words.en: A gibson is a cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, typically garnished with a pearl onion.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: The rules are too restrictive.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则太严格了。
words.en: Something that is restrictive prevents people from doing what they want to do, or from moving or acting freely.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: First, we need to eat; secondly, we need to study.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要吃饭；其次，我们需要学习。
words.en: You use secondly in speech or writing when you want to make a second point or give a second reason for something.

words.ex: She invited her friend to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请她的朋友吃晚饭。
words.en: To invite someone means to ask them to come to a social event or to spend time with you socially.

words.tr: v. 符合；“fit”的现在分词； adj. 恰当的；适合的；
words.ex: This shoe fits my foot perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
words.en: Appropriate or suitable for a particular purpose, person, occasion, etc.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.tr: n. 布罗卡（人名，常指大脑语言中枢布罗卡区）无中文释义
words.ex: Broca's area helps people speak clearly.
words.ex_cn: 布洛卡区帮助人们清晰地说话。

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.ex: The word 'bolen' is not a recognized English word.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bolen' 不是公认的英语单词。

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: The accident caused an impairment in his vision.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致了他的视力受损。
words.en: An impairment is a condition in which a part of a person's mind or body is damaged or does not work well.

words.ex: Myanmar is known for its rich culture and beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 缅甸以其丰富的文化和美丽的风景而闻名。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, officially known as the Republic of the Union of Myanmar, bordered by India, Bangladesh, China, Laos, and Thailand.

words.ex: Pierre is a common French name.
words.ex_cn: 皮埃尔是一个常见的法国名字。
words.en: Pierre is a masculine given name of French origin, meaning 'stone' or 'rock'.

words.ex: She wore a traditional Philippine dress to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件传统的菲律宾服装参加节日。
words.en: Of or relating to the Philippines or its people, culture, or language.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.ex: His behavioural changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to or involving behaviour.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.tr: v. 使含氟；在水中加入氟化物
words.ex: The city fluoridate the water to protect teeth.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在水中加氟以保护牙齿。

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: He is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 他只会说英语，不懂其他语言。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: Bushfires burned many trees last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，丛林大火烧毁了许多树木。
words.en: A bushfire is an uncontrolled fire in the bush that is a serious threat to life, property, and the environment.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.ex: He is exceptionally good at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面异常出色。
words.en: To an unusual degree; extremely.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If something varies or if you vary it, it becomes different or changed.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.tr: adj. 不适宜的；不合适的；
words.ex: This shirt is unsuitable for the cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫不适合寒冷的天气。
words.en: If someone or something is unsuitable for a particular purpose or situation, they are not appropriate for it.

words.ex: He didn't give up, even though some called him a loser.
words.ex_cn: 他没有放弃，即使有些人称他为失败者。
words.en: A loser is someone who is not successful in a particular situation or who does not achieve what they set out to do.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: The miner works deep underground.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在地下深处工作。
words.en: A miner is a person who works in a mine, extracting coal, gold, or other minerals.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无界限的；
words.ex: The sky looks limitless at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的天空看起来无边无际。
words.en: If you describe something as limitless, you mean that there is or appears to be so much of it that it will never be exhausted.

words.ex: Manatuto is a town in East Timor.
words.ex_cn: 马纳图托是东帝汶的一个城镇。

words.ex: Marschner is a surname, not a common English word.
words.ex_cn: Marschner 是一个姓氏，不是常见的英文单词。

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The authoritarian leader controls everything.
words.ex_cn: 这位专制的领导人控制一切。
words.en: An authoritarian government or leader has complete power and control over the people and does not allow political opposition.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: Yeshurun is a Hebrew name, often used in poetry and religious texts.
words.ex_cn: Yeshurun 是一个希伯来名字，常用于诗歌和宗教文本中。

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.ex: The kids get excited when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时会兴奋起来。
words.en: To excite someone means to cause them to feel very enthusiastic and eager.

words.ex: He undervalues his own talent.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了自己的才华。
words.en: If you undervalue something or someone, you fail to recognize how valuable or important they are.

words.ex: He displayed his photos on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片展示在墙上。
words.en: If you display something, you show it to people, or put it in a place where people can see it easily.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: The miner works deep underground.
words.ex_cn: 矿工在地下深处工作。
words.en: A miner is a person who works in a mine, extracting coal, gold, or other minerals.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无界限的；
words.ex: The sky looks limitless at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的天空看起来无边无际。
words.en: If you describe something as limitless, you mean that there is or appears to be so much of it that it will never be exhausted.

words.ex: Manatuto is a town in East Timor.
words.ex_cn: 马纳图托是东帝汶的一个城镇。

words.ex: Marschner is a surname, not a common English word.
words.ex_cn: Marschner 是一个姓氏，不是常见的英文单词。

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The authoritarian leader controls everything.
words.ex_cn: 这位专制的领导人控制一切。
words.en: An authoritarian government or leader has complete power and control over the people and does not allow political opposition.

words.ex: He failed the test, but subsequent efforts helped him pass.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，但随后的努力让他通过了。
words.en: Following in time or order; succeeding.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: Yeshurun is a Hebrew name, often used in poetry and religious texts.
words.ex_cn: Yeshurun 是一个希伯来名字，常用于诗歌和宗教文本中。

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The bike has a metal chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一条金属链条。
words.en: A chain consists of connected links which are typically made of metal, used for fastening or securing something, or for transmitting mechanical power.

words.ex: The kids get excited when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时会兴奋起来。
words.en: To excite someone means to cause them to feel very enthusiastic and eager.

words.ex: He undervalues his own talent.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了自己的才华。
words.en: If you undervalue something or someone, you fail to recognize how valuable or important they are.

words.ex: He displayed his photos on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片展示在墙上。
words.en: If you display something, you show it to people, or put it in a place where people can see it easily.
